id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a5d: "I was drinking in the hall back there, but the booze after a voyage tastes so good... I got plastered.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a68: "...Haaah. I could just lie down and sleep. I bet I'd have a good dream right now.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a76: "...Ugh. Maybe I drank too much. I had one terrifying dream.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a7e: "I was turned into a monster and ran wild. It felt strangely real. Weird, since that could never happen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a9b: "Ahoy-ho! A traveler, how rare! This is the hideout of us Vikings, who roam the northern seas.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4aa6: "What brings a wanderer to us? If you want Sniflheim's town, sail out and head east along the bay.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ab9: "...Ahoy-ho? It got dark outside before I knew it, and a castle floats in the sky instead of Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ac5: "When did that happen? I can't remember a thing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ad3: "...Ahoy-ho? The creepy castle in the sky is gone, and Yggdrasil floats there as always.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4adf: "Come to think of it, Yggdrasil couldn't just vanish. Was it a bad dream?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ae8: "...Then the blue-haired girl I saw around here earlier must have been a dream too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b01: "Repairing the ship, checking the cargo... and preparing the boss's booze.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b0c: "I only joined the Vikings recently, so I'm worked to the bone every day.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b1c: "Why is this... I woke up exhausted, and my whole body aches.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b26: "Ow, ow... I can't get any work done like this. The boss will chew me out.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b3b: "I'm the Vikings' bodyguard. Hired by a twist of fate years ago, and now I'm practically one of them.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b49: "...You seem to have your reasons. I don't know what they are, but if you have a goal, don't hang around here. Try elsewhere.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b5b: "I was away on business when that golden iceberg appeared. I finally made it back to the hideout.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b6a: "And these guys claim they've never heard of a golden iceberg. Talking nonsense, like sleepwalkers.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b7f: "Spending Sniflheim's cold nights alone makes me long for someone's warmth.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b88: "...Ah, if I had a woman to share them with, this loneliness would fade a little.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ba1: "Do you know Lizzlette? She's been coming to the tavern lately. An incredibly sexy woman.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bad: "I fell in love at first sight. I wanted to date her, so I worked up the courage and confessed.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bba: "I gave her a bouquet whose flower language means \"I love you.\"
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bc4: "She said she'd go out with me, and I thought, yes!! But there was one condition...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bd0: "She asked me to pick a rare flower that blooms at the Frozen Lake in Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bdc: "But I could never go somewhere as dangerous as Snaerfelt on my own, and I've been agonizing over it...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4be8: "Oh, I know! You look strong. Could you pick that flower for me? I'll thank you somehow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bfb: "...I see. Well, it's a lot to ask out of the blue. Can't be helped. I'll ask someone else.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c0d: "Really?! Great! The flower Lizzlette wants blooms at the Frozen Lake south of Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c19: "Bring me the flower when you get it. Whether I can date her is all up to you. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c39: "Bring me the flower when you get it. Whether I can date her is all up to you. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c2d: "The flower Lizzlette wants blooms at the Frozen Lake south of Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c4b: "Oh, it's you. That look on your face... Did you finally get that flower?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c55: "Huh? I can't date Lizzlette unless you bring the flower. Please hurry and get it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c75: "So this is the flower Lizzlette meant. A white blossom that blooms on the snowfield in the moonlight... a snow flower.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c84: "Now I can date her... no, wait. The flower language of the snow flower is...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c90: "...I see. She knew I wouldn't go myself, and that's why she set that condition.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c9a: "She's right. Asking a stranger to grant the wish of the one I love... I'm immature.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ca8: "But someday I'll get strong enough to pick this flower myself, and make Lizzlette turn her head.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cb3: "Thank you. Thanks to you, I realized how immature I am. Please take this as thanks.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cc5: "Oh, it's you. I've been training since then, but it's not easy to get strong.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cce: "But I won't give up. I'll definitely get strong and become a man worthy of Lizzlette!

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cf4: "The Vikings living west of Sniflheim are rough, but good-hearted folk.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d1b: "The Vikings living west of Sniflheim are rough, but good-hearted folk.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cfd: "They deliver tribute to Sniflheim, and in return the kingdom supports them with funds. We help each other.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d23: "They deliver tribute to Sniflheim, and in return the kingdom supports them with funds. We help each other.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d32: "By the way, I'm the kingdom's purveyor and liaison with them, and something worries me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d40: "The Vikings should be arriving at port with the tribute any day now, but the date has passed and they still haven't come.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d4d: "For rough men, keeping promises was their best trait. Something may have happened...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d57: "I know. You look like you have time on your hands. Could you find out what happened to the tribute?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d6c: "I see... But without that tribute, Lady Charlotte will be in a foul mood and lock herself in her room.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d82: "That's a relief. Without that tribute, Lady Charlotte would be in a foul mood and lock herself in her room.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d8d: "The Vikings' hideout is just west of Sniflheim. You'll get there quickly by ship.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4db6: "The Vikings' hideout is just west of Sniflheim. You'll get there quickly by ship.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d96: "Tell me once you learn where the tribute went. I'll reward you well, so I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4dbf: "Tell me once you learn where the tribute went. I'll reward you well, so I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4daa: "The tribute the Vikings were to deliver hasn't arrived, and I'm in a bind. Please find out where it went.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4dd4: "Oh, it's you. Did you hear from the Vikings?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e00: "Oh, it's you. Did you hear from the Vikings?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4dd9: "...What! A Viking went out to search for Lady Charlotte's tribute and is missing?!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4de4: "That's bad. Without that tribute, Lady Charlotte will be in a foul mood and lock herself in her room.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4dee: "Whatever it takes, find the Viking and make sure the tribute is delivered.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e05: "...Hm? What's that in your hands? Isn't that the Jumbo urchin, Lady Charlotte's tribute?!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e0e: "I don't know why you have it, but could you hand it over? I must deliver it to Lady Charlotte.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e1d: "I see... But without the tribute, I can't mend Lady Charlotte's mood. Please, could you spare it...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e34: "Oh! That glossy black body and fierce spines! This is surely Lady Charlotte's favorite, the Jumbo urchin!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e40: "You saved me. Without this, Lady Charlotte gets cross and won't come out of her room for three days.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e4c: "This was all thanks to you. I can't thank you enough. Allow me to give you my very best reward.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e60: "Thanks to the Jumbo urchin you gave me, Lady Charlotte's mood has improved and the Viking problem is solved.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e6a: "I can't thank you enough. My heartfelt thanks. Truly, thank you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e8f: "I wonder if he's safe. He's a tough guy, so I'm sure he's alive somewhere...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e9c: "I wonder if he's safe. He's a tough guy, so I'm sure he's alive somewhere...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4eb7: "Who are you? What do you want with us?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ebc: "...The kingdom's purveyor sent you to check on the Vikings, so you came all this way?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ec6: "Sorry for the trouble. A younger brother of ours who went to sea to find Lady Charlotte's tribute is missing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ed4: "We've been so busy sending ships out to find him that we couldn't even contact the merchant.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4edf: "But monsters at sea are giving us trouble in the search, and we don't know what to do...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4eea: "I know! You're traveling the world, right? If you see our brother on your journey, tell him we're looking for him.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ef8: "He vanished around the island due north on the world map, so he might be found around there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f06: "He's a dear brother we grew up with since we were kids. Please find him as soon as you can. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f3e: "He's a dear brother we grew up with since we were kids. Please find him as soon as you can. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f1e: "If you see our brother on your journey, tell him we're looking for him. I feel certain he's alive somewhere.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f2c: "He vanished near the island due north on the world map while searching for the tribute, so he might be found around there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f5a: "Oh, it's you. Did you meet our brother?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f87: "Oh, it's you. Did you meet our brother?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f5f: "...I see. He was stranded on a deserted island, gathering Jumbo urchins for the tribute?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f8d: "...I see. He was stranded on a deserted island, gathering Jumbo urchins for the tribute?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f6b: "Hahaha! That's just like him! He never falls without grabbing something! No need to worry about him anymore.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f98: "Hahaha! That's just like him! He never falls without grabbing something! No need to worry about him anymore.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f75: "Thanks for taking the time on your busy journey to tell us. We're grateful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fa3: "Thanks for taking the time on your busy journey to tell us. We're grateful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fc1: "When I'm a little older, I want to go to school and study.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fd9: "When I'm a little older, I want to go to school and study.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fc9: "It's the school my grandma went to. They say tiny, cute lilies of the valley bloom there by the hundreds!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fe1: "It's the school my grandma went to. They say tiny, cute lilies of the valley bloom there by the hundreds!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ff6: "Do you need something, big brother? ...A teacher asked you to find someone named Lilian?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5002: "Hehe, you're in luck, big brother. I know her.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|500a: "She must be my grandma. Her name is Lilian. Do you need her for something?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5019: "...Hmm, then maybe it's someone else? I hope you find the Lilian you're looking for soon.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5037: "A letter for Grandma? I'm sorry, traveling big brother. I can't pass this to her.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5047: "Grandma was born in Champs Sauvages. Monsters attacked and her hometown was lost.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5050: "So she had to work, and even though she wanted to study, she left school.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5059: "Grandma told me, \"Study hard and become a lovely lady.\"
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5062: "So when I'm a little older, I want to go to a school called Medal Academy.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|506e: "It's the school Grandma went to, where girls become lovely ladies.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5074: "Oops, I'm sorry! I only talked about myself. It was about the letter for Grandma, right?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|507f: "I can't hand it to her directly, but I'll leave it at her grave. I'm sure Grandma will be happy!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5091: "Grandma told me Medal Academy has a teacher named Milligan who's a real ogre.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50b3: "Grandma told me Medal Academy has a teacher named Milligan who's a real ogre.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|509b: "When Grandma played pranks, she'd chase her with a scary face. So frightening!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50bd: "When Grandma played pranks, she'd chase her with a scary face. So frightening!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50a3: "But whenever Grandma talked about that ogre, she always smiled happily. Isn't that odd?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50c5: "But whenever Grandma talked about that ogre, she always smiled happily. Isn't that odd?

tm.「……エイサホー？\n 気づいたら 外が暗くなってるし\n 空には 大樹じゃなく: "...Ahoy-ho? It got dark outside before I knew it, and a castle floats in the sky instead of Yggdrasil.
tm.「いつの間に そんなことに\n なってたんでやんしょ？\n あっし 何も思いだせ: "When did that happen? I can't remember a thing.
tm.「……エイサホー？\n 気づいたら 空の不気味な城が消えて\n いつも通り 大樹: "...Ahoy-ho? The creepy castle in the sky is gone, and Yggdrasil floats there as always.
tm.「考えてみたら 大樹が 無くなるハズもないし\n 悪い夢だったんでやんすかねー？: "Come to think of it, Yggdrasil couldn't just vanish. Was it a bad dream?
tm.「……ってことは さっき この辺りで\n 青い髪の女の子を 見かけたのも\n や: "...Then the blue-haired girl I saw around here earlier must have been a dream too.
tm.「船の修理に 積み荷の確認……\n それに 親分たちの酒の準備……っと。: "Repairing the ship, checking the cargo... and preparing the boss's booze.
tm.「あっしは このバイキングに入団して\n まだ日の浅い 新入りなもんで\n 毎日: "I only joined the Vikings recently, so I'm worked to the bone every day.
tm.「なぜでやんしょ……。\n 眠りからさめたら クタクタで\n その上 身体中が: "Why is this... I woke up exhausted, and my whole body aches.

tm.「あたしは バイキングどもの用心棒さ。\n くされ縁で 数年前に雇われて\n 今: "I'm the Vikings' bodyguard. Hired by a twist of fate years ago, and now I'm practically one of them.
tm.「……あんたは 何かワケありな感じだね。\n 事情は知らないけど 目的があるなら: "...You seem to have your reasons. I don't know what they are, but if you have a goal, don't hang around here. Try elsewhere.
tm.「ちょいと用事で 別の大陸にいってる間に\n あの 黄金の氷山が 出現してね。\: "I was away on business when that golden iceberg appeared. I finally made it back to the hideout.
tm.「それにしても こいつらときたら\n 黄金の氷山なんて 知らないってんだよ。\n: "And these guys claim they've never heard of a golden iceberg. Talking nonsense, like sleepwalkers.

tm.「……ああ 共に過ごす女性がいたら\n このさみしさも すこしは 紛れるのにな。: "...Ah, if I had a woman to share them with, this loneliness would fade a little.
tm.「キミは リーズレットさんを知ってるかい？\n 最近 よく酒場に 飲みに来る\n: "Do you know Lizzlette? She's been coming to the tavern lately. An incredibly sexy woman.
tm.「ボク ひと目見て 恋に落ちちゃってさ。\n なんとか お付き合いしたいと思って: "I fell in love at first sight. I wanted to date her, so I worked up the courage and confessed.

tm.「でも ボクのチカラじゃ シケスビア雪原なんて\n 危険な場所に 行けそうにない: "But I could never go somewhere as dangerous as Snaerfelt on my own, and I've been agonizing over it...
tm.「あっ そうだ！ キミは強そうだから\n 代わりに その花を摘んできてくれない？: "Oh, I know! You look strong. Could you pick that flower for me? I'll thank you somehow.
tm.「……そっか。まあ いきなり\n そんなこと言われても こまるよね。\n 仕方な: "...I see. Well, it's a lot to ask out of the blue. Can't be helped. I'll ask someone else.
tm.「ホントに！？ やった！ リーズレットさんが\n ほしがってる花は シケスビア雪: "Really?! Great! The flower Lizzlette wants blooms at the Frozen Lake south of Snaerfelt.
tm.「花を手に入れたら ボクに届けてくれ。\n ボクが 彼女と 付き合えるかどうかは: "Bring me the flower when you get it. Whether I can date her is all up to you. I'm counting on you.
tm.「リーズレットさんが ほしがってる花は\n シケスビア雪原の南にある\n 氷獄の: "The flower Lizzlette wants blooms at the Frozen Lake south of Snaerfelt.
tm.「やあ キミか。\n そのカオは もしかして……\n ついに 例の花が 手に入っ: "Oh, it's you. That look on your face... Did you finally get that flower?
tm.「えっ なんだよ。キミが 花を持ってこないと\n リーズレットさんと 付き合えな: "Huh? I can't date Lizzlette unless you bring the flower. Please hurry and get it.
